mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases when CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases when INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% annualized, the real interest rate is high, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases when FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL < 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases when RSAFS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases when INDPRO increases and UNRATE decreases.
